The attack model preview interface will display more attributes (type, range, cooldown =Time, damage, critical hit rate, etc.)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503495/2c33e489f5c2b0fd38d64771175c83bb83e3cd57.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Equipment[/p][p]1. tags.balance_change: 4. The victory countdown was changed to 10s
5. Reduced the number of targets in the task of killing enemies

1. Slash 1~4 changes the initial direction to: Automatic
2. Slash 1~4 reduced the cooldown time when equipped with small and medium weapons
3. Whirlwind 1~3 reduced the cooldown time when equipped with small and medium weapons

tags.feature: 4. The attack model preview interface will display more attributes (type, range, cooldown =Time, damage, critical hit rate, etc.)

tags.bug: 1. Fixed: When upgrading in battle, click preview attack model, and then click settings->exit, the battle data will display incorrectly.

notes.content:
1. Elite enemies have a 10% chance of dropping health-recovery items
2. Optimize map generation algorithm (reduce early difficulty)
3. Add new difficulty options: Easy, Normal

Easy
	Enemy birth frequency -50%
	Enemy health -25%
	Enemy attack frequency -50%

Normal
	Same as before
